intentional_behavior_changes.app_main: Idle startup; terminal/motor owner; optional SD; no automatic controller/replay.
intentional_behavior_changes.calc_task: Owned cancellable automatic operation; preparation moved to app; responsive polling retains one-second sample timeout.
intentional_behavior_changes.ecvt_fsm_motor_actions_enabled: Suppress state-entry motor actions on terminal cancellation.
intentional_behavior_changes.issue_running_position_command: Enforce explicit limits, propagate errors and observe cancellation.
intentional_behavior_changes.read_sample_data: Cooperative replay cancellation and return to caller; no readiness semaphore.
intentional_behavior_changes.sample_rpm_task: Pause and reset pulse timing between automatic runs.
intentional_behavior_changes.rx_dispatch_task: Capture synchronized servo feedback for stop/target confirmation.
intentional_behavior_changes.sd_writer_task: Persistent writer, explicit repeatable sessions, drain on stop.
intentional_behavior_changes.enqueue_log_record: Nonblocking admission independent of SD writes, closed-session rejection and counted drops.
intentional_behavior_changes.write_log_block: Count write losses and stop recording on a short write without stopping control.
intentional_behavior_changes.twai_rx_cb: Timestamp received frames before queueing for stale-feedback rejection.
intentional_behavior_changes.enqueue_replay_sensor: Initialize the new local receive metadata in synthetic frames.

changed_copies.src/servo/ECVT_motor.c: Bounded persistent TX storage, error propagation, cancellation and serialization guards; tested by motor harness.
changed_copies.src/control/ecvt_fsm.c: Cancellation-aware actions/waits and error propagation; no zero capture on cancelled wait.
changed_copies.platformio.ini: Terminal line entry uses the send_on_enter monitor filter.
changed_copies.src/servo/ECVT_motor.h: Adds bounded SDO reads for actual operating-mode verification and read-only drive/output inspection.
